title: OpenREL Normalized Constraint Registry
description: Reusable, typed constraint definitions for use in OpenREL/ODRL policies. Operators follow the ODRL 2.2 specification. All rightOperand values are typed. Free-text constraints from the draft have been normalized into structured entries.

constraints.label: Purpose — Academic Research
constraints.definition: Restricts use to declared academic research purposes as classified by DPV.
constraints.notes: Use odrl:neq variant to express the corresponding prohibition. Replaces draft's non-typed 'purpose=nonCommercial', 'purpose=educationalResearch', 'purpose=fairUse'.

constraints.label: Purpose — Non-Commercial
constraints.definition: Excludes commercial exploitation from permitted purposes.
constraints.notes: More precise than the draft's boolean 'nonCommercial' string. Commercial is expressed as exclusion of dpv:CommercialResearch rather than a positive claim.

constraints.label: Legal Basis — Consent
constraints.definition: Requires GDPR-compliant explicit consent as the legal basis for processing.
constraints.notes: Replaces draft's boolean 'consent=true/false' pattern, which is not valid in ODRL. Consent is expressed as a classification via dpv:hasLegalBasis.

constraints.label: Role — Researcher
constraints.definition: Restricts the permitted action to agents holding the 'Researcher' role as defined in DPV.

constraints.label: Role — Research Institution
constraints.definition: Restricts the action to accredited research institutions acting as data controllers.

constraints.label: Ethics Approval Required
constraints.definition: Requires documented ethics committee or IRB approval prior to access.
constraints.notes: The custom leftOperand 'openrel:requiresEthicsApproval' is defined in the OpenREL extension namespace. This replaces the draft's untyped 'ethicsApproval=true'.

constraints.label: Security Profile — TRUST+
constraints.definition: Requires the requesting connector to hold the IDS TRUST+ security certification.
constraints.notes: Sections 92, 106, and 119 are merged here: all express the same security profile constraint with minor label differences.

constraints.label: Security Profile — TRUST
constraints.definition: Requires the requesting connector to hold the IDS TRUST security certification.

constraints.label: Security Profile — BASE
constraints.definition: Requires the requesting connector to hold the IDS BASE security certification.

constraints.label: Technical and Organisational Measures Required
constraints.definition: Requires the data processor to implement specified Technical and Organisational Measures (TOMs) before access is granted.
constraints.notes: odrl:hasPart is used to express a composite requirement. The rightOperand is a typed array. Replaces the draft's untyped array without operator.

constraints.label: Maximum Data Volume (MiB)
constraints.definition: Limits each access request to a maximum of 100 MiB of data.
constraints.notes: The rightOperand value is a template; override per policy instance. The custom leftOperand 'openrel:dataVolumeMiB' is defined in the OpenREL namespace.

constraints.label: Spatial — European Union
constraints.definition: Restricts access to requests originating within EU member states. Uses a GeoNames URI for the EU as a typed geographic identifier.
constraints.notes: Sections 98 and 104 both express location-based access; merged into one canonical constraint with GeoNames URI instead of the draft's informal string 'eu'. Section 50 (cross-border governance) is handled at policy level.

constraints.label: Identity — Verified eIDAS
constraints.definition: Requires the agent to hold a verified digital identity issued by an eIDAS-compliant Trust Service Provider.
constraints.notes: The draft used a concrete identity URL as rightOperand, which is instance-specific. The canonical constraint uses a type reference; the concrete identity URI is set at policy instantiation.

constraints.label: Access Count — Maximum 5
constraints.definition: Limits the total number of times a resource may be accessed to 5.
constraints.notes: Sections 103, 109, and 114 are exact duplicates of a count-based access constraint. Merged into one parameterizable template. Override rightOperand per policy instance.

constraints.label: Access Duration — 10 Hours
constraints.definition: Limits access to a maximum of 10 hours from the start of the session.
constraints.notes: ISO 8601 duration format. Template: override PT10H per policy instance.

constraints.label: Access Duration — 24 Hours
constraints.definition: Limits access to a maximum of 24 hours from provisioning.

constraints.label: Time Interval Access Window (Template)
constraints.definition: Restricts access to a specific datetime interval. Both bounds must be evaluated simultaneously using a logical AND.
constraints.notes: Sections 101, 111, 116, and 117 all express interval-based access; Section 117 adds a deletion duty after the interval. The draft used a non-standard 'outside' operator — replaced here with two bounded constraints (gteq start AND lteq end). The prohibition is expressed as the logical complement. Concrete values are set at policy instantiation.
constraints.implementation_note: In ODRL, compound constraints use odrl:and / odrl:or refinements on the Constraint class.

constraints.label: Revocation Status — Active
constraints.definition: Permits access only if the provider has not flagged the dataset as revoked.
constraints.notes: The custom leftOperand and rightOperand are defined in the OpenREL extension namespace. The revocation check must be enforced at policy evaluation time.

constraints.label: Connector — Authorized URI (Template)
constraints.definition: Restricts access to a specific connector identified by URI.
constraints.notes: Sections 108 and 118 are duplicates. Merged into one template. The rightOperand URI is set at policy instantiation.

constraints.label: Notification Endpoint (Template)
constraints.definition: Specifies the URI of the endpoint that must receive a notification after each access event.
constraints.notes: Sections 102, 107, and 113 all express notification duties with different endpoint URLs. Merged into one template. The draft used 'definesAs' and 'isNull' — neither are ODRL operators. 'odrl:recipient' is the correct ODRL left operand for notify constraints. The draft operator 'isNull' is replaced by encoding absence as a prohibition with no endpoint defined.

constraints.label: Logging Target — Clearing House (Template)
constraints.definition: Specifies the URI of the clearing house or audit system that must receive each access log entry.

constraints.label: Data Minimization
constraints.definition: Requires that only data strictly necessary for the stated purpose is collected or stored.
constraints.notes: Replaces the draft's untyped 'dataMinimization' constraint. Expressed as a boolean compliance flag in the OpenREL namespace.

constraints.label: Open Access Required
constraints.definition: Requires that the resource be made available under open access terms, typically in a public repository.
constraints.notes: Consolidates the draft's 'repository=openAccess', 'availability=public', 'licenseCompliance=true' patterns into a single typed constraint.

constraints.label: Attribution Required
constraints.definition: Requires that the original creator or rights holder be credited when the resource is used, shared, or published.
constraints.notes: The draft modelled attribution inconsistently: sometimes as a constraint ('attribution=false' in prohibitions), sometimes as an action ('provideAttribution'). Normalized here as a boolean constraint; the corresponding duty is openrel:attribute.

constraints.label: Share-Alike Required
constraints.definition: Requires that derivatives be distributed under the same or a compatible licence (copyleft condition).
constraints.notes: Replaces draft's 'licenseType=CreativeCommonsBY-SA' which was too specific. ShareAlike is a structural condition, not a licence reference.

constraints.label: Funding Source — Public
constraints.definition: Identifies the resource as publicly funded, triggering open access obligations.
